432827456.body: ps5 mihawkos-v8.0.0-alpha-8 mihawkos is a passion project, not a piracy project it exists so you can play the games you own on the console you own piracy is not condoned no games, saves, keys, firmware or exploits are included, and they never will be use only games and programs you have the right to run : your own copies, bought or installed by you requests for, or links to, games, keys, firmware or exploits are not welcome in this project s issues or discussions a glass control panel over every game. your controller in more games. steadier frames, and far fewer freezes the eighth alpha of mihawkos, the homebrew title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own mihawk os. it is still experimental. from 7.1, mihawkos offers this update by itself. the first start after updating takes longer, once: every windows setup refreshes its windows files a single time what s new: control overlay : exit, live statistics, keyboard, mouse and controller, over any game what s new: your controller in more games : xbox 360, xbox one or dualsense, switched while you play what s new: steadier frames : games wait for the tv like on a pc, 119.8 fps at 120 hz what s new: typing in real time : the on-screen keyboard types into the game key by key what s new: online games connect again : web requests through windows winhttp work what s new: fewer freezes and crashes for games inside mihawkos, and no black screen in spelunky 2 what s new: visual c already installed : games stop asking what s new: steam warns before it runs out of room on older firmware the control overlay press l3 r3 during a game. a frosted-glass panel opens over it, the game still running behind, with five buttons exit ends the game and brings you back to mihawkos statistics shows a small box in the top-left corner: frame rate, frame time, gpu load, and the console s page tables in both pools, so you can see when a game is near the console s limits. it costs the game about 0.2 ms per frame keyboard opens mihawkos s own on-screen keyboard mouse turns the mouse off and on while you play controller changes which controller the game sees, xbox 360, xbox one or dualsense , while it runs. the panel says what to expect from each one the panel keeps a 120 hz game smooth while it is open: 119.8 to 119.9 frames per second, measured on the console your controller in more games games that never saw the controller now do. until 7.1, only games that use xinput found your controller. games that read it through directinput, raw input, winmm or sdl, and the engines built on them, now find it too ys origin , which never saw the controller before, now responds to it in the xbox 360 and xbox one layouts the controller is ready 25 to 70 ms after a game starts in dualsense mode, some older games number the buttons the way windows does cross is button 2 . that is expected pick an xbox layout in the overlay for those games typing in real time the on-screen keyboard types into the game as you go , one key at a time, instead of all at once at the end backspace deletes in the game no stray q appears when the keyboard opens thanks to the tester who reported it online games connect again games and launchers that go online through windows winhttp could not connect : every request was refused before it left the console. they now connect, inside mihawkos and outside it, checked on the console against a test server steadier frames games wait for the tv, as on a pc. a game with vsync on now holds 119.8 fps at 120 hz and 59.9 fps at 60 hz without the extra frame limiter that caused the camera and input lag some players reported fable, for example games running below your tv s resolution reach the screen 3.3 times faster fewer freezes and crashes unity games no longer freeze themselves. a game that paused one of its own threads at the wrong moment could stop forever. our test program pauses and resumes a game s threads 300 times in a row: it now passes every time, inside mihawkos and outside it 10 of 10 runs on the console no more freeze when a game s crash reporter starts games inside mihawkos no longer damage mihawkos s own memory , a rare cause of crashes and odd behaviour games inside mihawkos no longer collide with the graphics driver s memory. a game, or a browser built into it could be handed memory the graphics driver also used, and crash later games keep their own thread priorities , so audio and input threads react on time, never above mihawkos itself games started from a launcher or a steam shortcut , also on another drive, keep their library setting and run inside mihawkos like the rest of your library no more black screen in games that ask for more memory than any ps5 has , such as spelunky 2 from steam mihawkos now places such a request elsewhere by itself, with no setting per game direct3d 12 games get twice the graphics upload memory inside mihawkos 2 gib instead of 1 , so games that ran out of it at start stop failing there. checked on the console: a game inside mihawkos reached 1,984 mib games that time their frames with the gpu s clock now get real readings they all read 0 before games learn which processor core each of their threads runs on ; until now every thread was told core 0 a freeze leaves a record. if a game stops drawing for about 20 seconds, mihawkos writes a snapshot of what it was doing into the log, so a freeze report shows where it stuck crash logs say where a game crashed : the file, the place in it, the address it touched and the thread, also for games that catch their own crashes. please send your log with every crash report visual c already installed every windows setup now says visual c 2010, 2012 and 2013 are installed , next to 2015 2022, which were already recorded. launchers and installers that check before starting a game stop asking a game s own visual c installer still works: it finishes quietly tested on the console: install 9.7 s, exit 0 steam on consoles with little room steam needs about 2,000 of the console s 8,192 system page tables. on firmware 10.xx to 11.xx there is often less room. if fewer than 2,800 are free, mihawkos now stops steam as it starts and shows what to do, instead of letting it fail halfway steam itself works as in 7.1 played on the console this release s build was tested on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 , with every file on the console checked against the build the full test battery of 137 cases on a freshly restarted console, on the final build: 135 passed, and the 2 dns cases passed with one check each skipped by a test-network setting run a8final-base-2026-11-03-gate the thread-pause test, 10 runs 5 inside mihawkos, 5 outside : all passed, about 17 18 s each 7.1 updating itself to alpha 8 over an existing 7.1 setup: passed: 7.1 found alpha 8, downloaded it, checked its signature and switched; the next start installed the new windows runtime in 31 s, and the first game afterwards ran alpha 8 s windows files, in the runtime and in the existing setup, checked file by file the control overlay: its buttons, the statistics box checked against the console s own frame counter and 120 hz with the panel open controller: 13 of 13 checks in every layout known limits not fixed yet on the controller: camera drift, the create button, the touchpad as a mouse, the steam input cursor and input lag. they are planned for a later update steam s browser still runs beside mihawkos , not inside it. moving it inside lighter on the console , and letting a game take the room steam used when it starts, come in 8.1 restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts; mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode with payloads loaded not supported: drm such as denuvo, and anti-cheat such as easy anti-cheat or battleye everything else from 7.1 still applies installing or updating ps5 cloud upload before it closes what s new: new handover screens : getting your game ready and welcome back , on the game s own artwork steam s browser runs inside mihawkos big picture s store, library and sign-in pages are drawn by steam s built-in browser. in alpha 8 it ran as a separate program beside mihawkos; now it runs inside it far lighter on the console: about 710 of the console s page tables in ten minutes of browsing, against about 1,870 before base ps5, firmware 13.60 pages scroll at about 120 fps your game comes first when you press play on a game in big picture, steam now steps aside so the game gets all the room on the console 1. mihawkos shows getting ready and asks steam to close. steam saves its session and closes by itself 2. the game starts with steam running quietly behind it, and nothing else 3. when you quit the game, mihawkos shows welcome back , steam saves to steam cloud and closes, and big picture opens again where you left it measured on a base ps5 with the resident evil 3: raccoon city demo: about 6,200 page tables free during play, against about 5,300 in alpha 8, at 110 to 120 fps this handover is for 64-bit games . a 32-bit game started from big picture runs as it did in alpha 8: beside steam with no handover screens, and steam syncs its cloud saves as usual when it ends. 32-bit games join the handover in a later update the failed to start process for this game: general failure 0x1f pop-up that could flash when you pressed play is gone. if steam ever stops responding during a handover, mihawkos asks whether to keep waiting or close steam cloud saves you can trust when a game ends, mihawkos now waits until steam has seen it end. steam does its steam cloud upload first, and only then is it asked to close. on the console, steam s own log shows the upload completing two seconds before steam closed new handover screens getting ready and welcome back , each with a short checklist that ticks off what has really happened steam saving its session, room being made for the game, the game starting, the cloud save, big picture reopening drawn in frosted glass over the game s own steam artwork , read from steam s library on the console. games without artwork get the aero sky in all 10 languages the screen stays up until the game s first frames take over, in one step, without flicker also fixed settings shows release names. the update check reads alpha 8.1 and alpha 8 instead of a raw number such as 01.003.000 , which could appear cut off as 1 every windows setup gets the new built-in files when mihawkos updates. until picture and the game. it is next on the list big picture can still hitch now and then while pages load. smoothing it out comes after 8.1 not fixed yet on the controller: camera drift, the create 432776365.body: new ampr-emu-ng v0.2.0. the bundled ampr-emu-ng is now its v0.2.0 release. games carrying v0.1.0 are still recognized. the ampr tile shows the runtime and its version custom packing rules. zstd and lz4 pack take a toml profile that decides which files are packed and which stay loose: the pack tab s custom rules fold, or cli --pack-profile . the file can be on this device, a paired device or a saved nas. see docs packing.md smarter built-in packing. protected and video folders match in any case, insomniac s sound and movie containers stay loose, and the job log says why each group of files stays loose fixes much faster with many small files: inspecting gran turismo 7 95,382 files on windows went from 185-430 s to 4-5 s, and folder outputs write small files on 4 threads a folder output writes sce sys and eboot.bin last, so shadowmount never finds a half-written game a packed game whose packs also hold a file that is on disk lz4 or zstd is no longer refused: an identical copy keeps the plain file, otherwise the packed copy is used thanks luanquanzteixeira made their first contribution in 17: scanned files are opened for their attributes only on windows, behind the much faster inspection above
bullets: ampr-emu-ng v0.2.0. the bundled ampr-emu-ng is now its v0.2.0 release. games carrying v0.1.0 are still recognized. the ampr tile shows the runtime and its version

custom packing rules. zstd and lz4 pack take a toml profile that decides which files are packed and which stay loose: the pack tab s custom rules fold, or cli --pack-profile . the file can be on this device, a paired device or a saved nas. see docs packing.md
smarter built-in packing. protected and video folders match in any case, insomniac s sound and movie containers stay loose, and the job log says why each group of files stays loose
much faster with many small files: inspecting gran turismo 7 95,382 files on windows went from 185-430 s to 4-5 s, and folder outputs write small files on 4 threads
a folder output writes sce sys and eboot.bin last, so shadowmount never finds a half-written game
a packed game whose packs also hold a file that is on disk lz4 or zstd is no longer refused: an identical copy keeps the plain file, otherwise the packed copy is used
luanquanzteixeira made their first contribution in 17: scanned files are opened for their attributes only on windows, behind the much faster inspection above

434932786.body: new ampr-emu-ng v0.3.0. the bundled runtime is the v0.3.0 release, which serves fully packed zstd and lz4 games pack any game. pack now works on games whose eboot.bin doesn t import libsceampr . it installs ampr-emu-ng at fakelib libsceampr.sprx , which shadowmount loads pack everything. zstd pack, and lz4 pack with ampr-emu-ng, now pack everything except system files eboot.bin , executables and modules, sce sys , sce module , fakelib , the runtime s own files , so audio, video and configs get packed too picker shortcuts. add shortcut pins the folder shown, on any device, up to 9 in all. every picker lists them as chips above the files; click one to open that folder fixes zstd pack reads and compresses each file once. the rule that stored a whole file uncompressed when it saved under 1 is gone; only the chunks zstd can t shrink are stored raw, so large, barely compressible files no longer cost a second read archives and fpkg files on another device used to be missing from the picker. they are now listed greyed out, with a note that they open from this device only thanks libraaaaa2792 reported 18, which brought the picker shortcuts dexil123 reported 20, which made archives on another device show in the picker
